description: A checked link that opens an Animal Math worksheet maker set up with the given settings, the settings in words, and anything it could not use. Also gives the maker's set item, to put it in a set with make_set_link.

settings.description: Setting id to value, from get_maker_settings; a value by its id or its words: {"mode": "drawHands", "minuteIncrement": "15", "answerKey": 1}. headerText sets the worksheet's title.

name: build_maker_link
title: Link to a worksheet maker
